notes: Derived from the official Census 2022 cartographic county boundaries retained in az-counties-2022.geojson. La Paz County was created in 1983 from northern Yuma County, so for 1966-1982 the Yuma feature is the dissolved union of today's Yuma and La Paz polygons. Other counties are unchanged. This is an approximation: later minor boundary adjustments are not modelled, and no geometry is hand-drawn.
